items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Archie Shepp spent at least four days working on his music at this very piano. [INTERVIEWEE] Really?

ctx.x: And if it's any time to talk about her it's now with the play 'Lady Day' (Betty Davis) which I saw. And by the way, Archie Shepp spent at least four days working on his music at this very piano.
